entities.name: John George IV, Elector of Saxony
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: John George IV was Elector of Saxony from 1691 to 1694. He belonged to the Albertine branch of the House of Wettin and was the eldest son of John George III, Elector of Saxony and Anna Sophie of Denmark.
